# AccessiBooks

> AccessiBooks is an accessible audiobooks and e-reading platform from Australian Disability Ltd, providing 3,000+ audiobooks, ebooks, and magazines designed for people with disabilities.

## Key Sections

- Homepage / entry point: https://accessibooks.org/
- Browse catalog (audiobooks, ebooks, magazines): https://accessibooks.org/library
- Search: https://accessibooks.org/search
- Pricing & subscription plans (Free, Plus, Premium): https://accessibooks.org/pricing
- About AccessiBooks and accessibility mission: https://accessibooks.org/about
- Support & contact: https://accessibooks.org/support

## Content

- Individual book pages: https://accessibooks.org/book/{id}
- Author pages: https://accessibooks.org/author/{name}
- Reading clubs: https://accessibooks.org/clubs
- Live author events: https://accessibooks.org/events

## Browse Collections

Server-rendered, crawler-friendly collection pages with real catalogue data:

- Accessible collections hub: https://accessibooks.org/accessible
- Auslan video companion titles: https://accessibooks.org/accessible/auslan
- Titles with transcripts: https://accessibooks.org/accessible/with-transcripts
- Dyslexia-friendly titles: https://accessibooks.org/accessible/dyslexia-friendly
- Easy Read titles: https://accessibooks.org/accessible/easy-read
- Captioned titles: https://accessibooks.org/accessible/captioned
- Audio-described titles: https://accessibooks.org/accessible/audio-described
- Human-narrated audiobooks: https://accessibooks.org/accessible/human-narrated
- Reading-level collections: https://accessibooks.org/accessible/very-easy-reading (also easy-reading, moderate-reading, advanced-reading)
- Browse by genre: https://accessibooks.org/collections
- Free audiobooks: https://accessibooks.org/collections/free-audiobooks
- Sitemap index: https://accessibooks.org/sitemap.xml

## Accessibility Features

AccessiBooks is purpose-built for users with disabilities. Key features include:
- Easy English simplified reading mode
- Adjustable fonts, contrast, and dyslexia mode
- Switch access and screen reader optimisations
- Auslan (Australian Sign Language) video companions on select titles
- Live captions and saved transcripts for author events and reading clubs
- Text-to-speech narration for ebooks
- Caregiver and therapist progress reports (literacy and listening goals)

## Content Sources

Titles are sourced from LibriVox (public domain audiobooks), Project Gutenberg, Internet Archive, Open Library, and iTunes. The catalog spans fiction, non-fiction, children's, and educational titles.

## Subscriptions

Three tiers: Free (limited access), Plus (expanded catalog), and Premium (full catalog + exclusive features). Subscriptions managed via Stripe.
